items.question: Which feminine form is described as skull-and-noose-bearing and fear-causing to all enemies?
premises: The verse names a skull-and-noose-bearing feminine form.
The same form is said to cause fear to all enemies.
The pronoun seyam identifies the described subject.
items.inference: The verse identifies a goddess-like feminine power marked by skull, noose, and enemy-terrifying force.
uncertainties: The exact deity or ritual context is not specified by these three tokens alone.
items.plain_english: She, this skull-and-noose-bearing form, causes fear to all enemies.
